meta.name: Tamil Idol
meta.description: Tamil Idol is not just a singing show, it's The Largest Tamil Voice Movement Ever Attempted.​ Tamil Idol travels across Tamil Nadu and global Tamil communities, collecting voices, stories and musical identities. From lakhs of voices emerges one defining Tamil Idol.​

videos.title: The Search for Tamil Nadu's Next Singing Star
videos.overview: Hopeful singers take center stage as the search for exceptional talent begins with memorable auditions and first impressions.

videos.title: The Top 16 Are Here!
videos.overview: The competition heats up as Tamil Idol’s Top 16 are revealed, marking the beginning of an exciting new chapter in their musical journey.

videos.title: The Top 17 Take The Spotlight
videos.overview: The Grand Premiere celebrates Tamil Idol's Top 17 contestants as they showcase their talent, marking the start of an exciting musical journey.

videos.title: 17 Voices One Dream
videos.overview: Seventeen talented contestants begin their musical journey, captivating the stage with inspiring performances and big dreams.

videos.title: E5. Blockbuster Diwali Special - Part 1
videos.overview: Celebrity MasterChef stars, Hip Hop Adhi and Tamil Idol contestants light up Diwali with music, fun and festive entertainment.

videos.title: Blockbuster Diwali Special - Part 2
videos.overview: The Diwali celebrations continue as Celebrity MasterChef stars, Hip Hop Adhi and Tamil Idol contestants spread festive cheer.

videos.title: Pyaar Prema Kaadhal – A Celebration Of Love
videos.overview: The Pyaar Prema Kaadhal round celebrates love through memorable performances, while GV Prakash shares stories from his musical journey. A surprise appearance and standout acts add to the excitement.

videos.title: Pyaar Prema Kaadhal - Part 2
videos.overview: The Pyaar Prema Kaadhal round continues with soulful performances, GV Prakash's insights, a surprise for Aakash and Lavanya's standout act.

videos.title: Endrendrum Deva
videos.overview: Endrendrum Deva is a heartfelt tribute to legendary composer Deva, featuring nostalgic performances of his iconic hits. With special guest Srikanth Deva sharing cherished memories, the episode celebrates the timeless music and enduring legacy of a true musical legend.

videos.title: Endrendrum Deva - Part 2
videos.overview: Contestants celebrate legendary composer Deva’s timeless legacy through vibrant performances, nostalgic tributes and cherished memories.
